title: skills(objectstack-data): the data-hooks reference still filters task on a hand-named owner, not owner_id (follow-up of #33560)
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb

Filing gate: ① (a follow-up owed by work in flight: the at-tier contract review 6891083453 on PR #33720, card #33560, found this outside its diff, by reading).

PR #33555 (card #33506) teaches that a record's owner is the injected `owner_id`, and PR #33720 (card #33560) moved the ui, query and automation examples onto it. `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` line 304 (on `main`) still filters `task` on a hand-named `{ owner: uid }`, the same family the two PRs retired. An agent copying it declares or reads an `owner` field beside the injected one.

## What lands

Point the example at `owner_id`. No restatement of the data rule. `@objectstack/skills` patch changeset. `skills/**` only, `Clause-②: no`.
